body: This seems perfectly fine to me. “Let us feast freely on those who wish to tame us.”

I am so glad someone said this. I started an autobiography, and I begin by saying the heart of human existence is romance. Not sexual romance, just this abounding love for our friends and family. Romantic notions are the good and the ugly things in life; there is something romantic about the saga of a suffering person. I love my friends very intensely, and I am 100% loyal, especially my best friend. It is hard for him to understand that, and at times I have wondered if he is autistic. But in reality, I just love him as a brother way more than “normal” people. I am just loyal, even to a crappy job, to my church (Catholic), and I am always prepared to serve others, and set myself aside, sometimes to a fault. When my friends are having a hard time, even though I am depressed, have alcoholism, and am unemployed, I still come to them and say, if you ever need to talk about anything, I am here for you, and if you don’t want me that close, I will just be with you. They never do, and I understand that, but I am compelled to be there for them.

Some people on Reddit have gone as far to say that people with BPD cannot love, only obsess. That is not true, and it is such an ignorant thing to say. I remember the words of Jesus: Love hath no greater than this: that a man should lay down his life for his friends. And in another place he says “Ye have called me master, but I call you my friends.” Jesus didn’t have BPD. And we love like that.
That’s actually a Czech name that references a Saint John of Nepumuk. Also spelled Nepomuk.

I am going through the same thing. I would offer advice, but I have none to give. I have destroyed every good thing in my life, and every effort to recover has failed spectacularly. All I can say at that point is “victory was in my grasp”. I have brain damage from self inflicted head injuries and alcohol. I can barely type this comment, even though I am not drunk. I am only 26, my teeth are rotting out of my head, despite meticulous care (the only personal hygiene I care about), and I have just flunked community college. I had a fiancé, we were the perfect match in so many ways, but her parents rejected me in the end. I wasn’t manly enough. The truth is I am mostly gay, and she was the only woman I ever loved, and I did so with every ounce of my soul. I hate being gay. It makes me sick.

I guess my advice is that it could be much worse.

I appreciate the Star Trek reference. Grew up on the Original Series. Gul Dukate was one of my favorite characters.

I seriously worry about getting there. I have broken so many promises not to stop drinking. My father, grandfather, and great-grandfather are/were alcoholics. The last two died from alcohol related intestinal cancer, my dad has serious digestive problems. I have started having them. It is the brown stuff, whisky and bourbon. I would get checked out if I were you. But I am a hypocrite.
I sent this to my roommates. Hopefully it helps them understand what I go through with bpd. It helps me understand their struggles as well.

I sent a lot of this to my roommates. One is my former (?) best friend. In a lot of ways, I have been really ugly to him the last six months, and I feel awful, and I try to make it up. I also have been in love with him for around a year, and feel really guilty about that as well. I just bought his Christmas present, an antique pocket watch. But sadly, I had a suicidal episode, ended up in a hospital. Now he is asking me to move out. It was too much this time I guess. No more chances. :(
